candidates.statement: Gateway checkout 502s (~2s) stem from downstream latency: order calls to payment /v1/authorizations hit ReadTimeout (~2s) in traces, and gateway logs show transport errors to order. Payment authorizations eventually return 200 after ~3s, indicating slow payment responses exceeding the client timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side spans or metrics; payment slowness inferred from gateway/order traces only.

report.explanation: Checkout returns 502 with ~2s durations. Traces show order->payment ReadTimeout errors while inventory/redis succeed, and payment authorizations complete ~3s later. Gateway logs confirm transport errors to order. This points to downstream latency at payment exceeding the client timeout, propagating 502s to checkout.
